summary: Wired the pure ruins into MatchRoom (protocol v8). Every source now starts locked (the rubbings-theft unlock-all is removed). The ruins are dealt from their own master-secret seed (deriveSeed 'ruins'). The first solve's sources-unlocked calls unlockSource, and each solver's gold-awarded calls grantGold (reason ruin, key String(island)). The room reports presence every tick in play, so casting off, a duel or a disconnect closes the session, and a leave closes it at once. New zod-validated messages: open-ruin/ruin-clue (the clue goes to the opener only, strictly parsed) and answer-ruin/ruin-result (idempotent by request id, the last 16 remembered; opens and answers share a cap of 8/s; read only in play). Private status carries the ruin state, session and lockout. Per-island ruin markers are view-filtered by sight. Test-only ruins (env PIRATE_SEA_RACE_TEST_RUINS, the next-match route, MatchTuning.testRuins) open islands or pin a kind through derived ruins:<n> seeds. Integration quickStart and the browser server open every island, so theft-loop and full-match use the test-only unlock. Web: ruinPanel.ts (tablets with inscriptions, 4x4 grid, keys 1-6 / arrows / WASD / Backspace / Enter / Escape, clicks, lockout countdown, '+40 gold' and unlock lines), R in the HUD, neutral helm while the panel is open. Carried P2s: recordedOutcomes is bounded to 64 (outcomes.ts, with a unit test), and the banner re-arm and auto-hide have fake-timer tests plus rows 286-288 in match-online-coverage.md. docs/ruins-online-coverage.md has 188 rows (159 tested, 15 equivalent, 14 removed), each built by deleting the branch on scratch copies in parallel lanes. Checks executed here: npm run typecheck (pass), npm run test:unit (1311 pass), npm run test:integration (115 pass, 175 s), npm run build (pass, including the smoke), the full playwright suite with the JSON reporter (13 pass), and check-report (all 11 scenarios ok).
open_assumptions: An island is 'in sight' when the nearest point of its rectangle is within the sight radius. The marker is placed at the island's centre.
Opening a ruin that someone else already unlocked is still offered (R), because solving it pays that player's own 40 gold.
docs/ruins.md (not an owned path) still says the ruins aren't wired into MatchRoom. It needs a one-line update by its owner.

The e2e scenarios other than ruin-solve run with every island open (PIRATE_SEA_RACE_TEST_RUINS=*=open in the Playwright config). ruin-solve and the navigation test ask for locked ruins through the next-match route.
verify_yourself: Play one match with no test settings (npm run dev without PIRATE_SEA_RACE_TEST_RUINS) and check that a fresh ruin takes about 20-40 s including the 6 s rubbing, reading the clue from the panel as a real player would. The timing claim rests on the pure module's reader/guesser analysis and on the browser test, not on a human playtest.
